column-count.$description: The maximum number of columns in a narrow window. The medium and wide windows have their own.

column-gap.$description: Matches the gap between the columns of the Grid, so the columns line up with its Cells.

column-width.$description: The minimum width of a column. A Cell too narrow for the column count shows fewer columns.

column-count.$description: The maximum number of columns in a medium window, from the medium breakpoint of the Grid.
The maximum number of columns in a wide window, from the wide breakpoint of the Grid.
